capabilities: Render a Bases table view that repeats a note under each list value
Reuse the existing Group by configuration with no extra options
Paginate groups at 50 rows with a Show more control
Lazily render group tables near the viewport for large bases
extras: Explicitly designed to be retired once core Bases adds this behaviour; unsupported features include inline editing, kanban/cards layouts, nested groups and collapsing; desktop only, untested on mobile; tested on Obsidian 1.13.7 and 1.14.3.
intentEvidence: This is the behaviour asked for in the forum thread Make a note fall into multiple groups.
motivation: The author built it to answer a forum request for notes to fall into multiple groups.
problem: Core Bases groups notes by the whole list value, so a note with a multi-value list property appears only in one combined group rather than under each value.
summary: A Bases table view that lists a note under every value of a grouped list property instead of one combined group.
